chapter: A Special Blend, A Timeless Masterpiece
act_title: A Special Blend, A Timeless Masterpiece

quests.title: A Special Blend, A Timeless Masterpiece

dialogue.t: Hey there, {NICKNAME}! All wrapped up for the day?
Paimon hears you did a great job holding down the fort while she was out delivering drinks with Glenfidia!

dialogue.sit: I got some great ideas from chatting with everyone!

dialogue.t: ...Whatever the reason, the Honorary Knight is clearly one of the most talented mixologists in Mondstadt.
Considering how short a time he's(she's) been doing this, I believe that someday, he(she) has the potential to give the legendary bartender at The Cat's Tail a run for her money.
I fully support your decision, Grand Master. The Honorary Knight has really put in the hard yards.

The drinks stand will remain open for a little while longer to provide a proper welcome to our returning expedition members. Then, once we locate suitable premises, we also plan to look at operating a permanent service...
Hooray! Everyone in the Knights of Favonius will get to drink all the delicious cocktails they like!
Nothing short of what I'd expect from a true disciple of Hertha. You've really considered this thoroughly, Glenfidia!
Also, if I may, Honorary Knight, regarding the special cocktails you've developed... Would you mind leaving the recipes with us? We'd like to add them to the official menu.

dialogue.sit: Of course! That way, everyone can try them!
It would be selfish not to!

dialogue.t: Hmm... Paimon feels like there's something you still want to say... Let Paimon have a guess...
Based on your personality, you probably want... to introduce the origin of each different cocktail!
That way, customers will know who inspired you to create these amazing drinks!

dialogue.sit: Right on the Mora! You know me so well, Paimon!
I think that's what everyone would want, right?

dialogue.t: No problem at all! If you need, I can even have someone draft the paperwork on your behalf to secure you the rights to these new recipes.
Haha, I hope when we recruit some new bartenders, they'll be able to learn from your incredible skills...
Even if they can't quite match your work, if they can be two-thirds as good, that would still make them industry leaders!

quests.description: After running the drinks stand for a while, your creations have received widespread acclaim and are about to become new classics…
